edges.reason: msg.sender is compared to owner inside the restricted modifier of setCompleted.
The owner state variable is the trusted principal checked by the restricted modifier.
upgrade is restricted by the same msg.sender == owner check.
upgrade instantiates the new contract and calls setCompleted on it.
sendValue performs the low-level value transfer to the recipient.
recipient.call forwards control to an arbitrary address, which may reenter the calling contract.
SkaleToken.mint delegates to the internal ERC777._mint routine.
CAP.sub(totalSupply()) bounds the minted amount and is arithmetic sensitive.
Minting increases the total supply tracked by the token.
_mint adds the amount to _totalSupply before external hooks.
_mint credits the recipient balance in _balances.
_mint invokes _callTokensReceived, executing recipient code during minting.
_callTokensReceived dispatches an external call to the recipient hook implementation.
The untrusted tokensReceived hook can reenter the token's transfer/mint paths.
transfer calls _callTokensToSend before mutating balances.
_callTokensToSend dispatches an external call to the sender hook implementation.
The untrusted tokensToSend hook can reenter the token contract.
transfer performs the balance movement through _move.
_send finishes by calling _callTokensReceived on the destination.
_move reads and writes the balances mapping.
Minting triggers the _beforeTokenTransfer hook overriding lock checks.
_beforeTokenTransfer resolves the TokenState locker through contractManager to read locked balance.
nonReentrant guards the overridden _callTokensToSend entry point.
nonReentrant guards the overridden _callTokensReceived entry point.
_status is read and written by the nonReentrant modifier to block reentrancy.
initialize grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to msg.sender during deployment.
initialize stores the ContractManager address that gates all contract lookups.
confiscate is restricted by the allow modifier comparing msg.sender to the Punisher address.
retrieve reads and clears the caller's approved amount.
retrieve indexes the approved mapping with _msgSender().
_totalApproved is maintained with add/sub arithmetic when approvals change and consumed on retrieve.
adjustPrice depends on now for the cooldown check and for the elapsed-time term.
adjustPrice adds or subtracts the computed change on the price state variable.
broadcast validates the exchanged shares through _checkCorrectMultipliedShare.
_generateGroup derives its selection randomness from blockhash(block.number - 1).
selectNodeToGroup derives node selection randomness from blockhash(block.number - 1).

normalization_plan.reason: The completed argument only feeds the last_completed_migration update inside setCompleted, so it normalizes into the enclosing function.
new_address is used solely to build the upgraded instance within upgrade and carries no independent security semantics.
recipient is the destination of the value transfer performed by sendValue and belongs to that function scope.
success is the immediate return value of the low-level call, so it merges into the unsafe operation node.
amount is the minted quantity consumed by _mint for supply and balance updates and is scoped to that function.
